items.text:
Personally, I love this game. It's the perfect amount of hardcore, survival, management, basebuilding. Sure, it may have some bugs but because the game is so neat, I often overlook them while knowing they will get fixed by the great dev team. 

The graphics are on the low end, but It's right up my alley. I prefer mechanics and gameplay over graphics. At times, I even feel that the graphics perfectly fit the style of the game.

The audio is actually outstanding. The alerts, the beeps, the sounds of your tools, etc. Its all great and perfectly matches the style.

The management is a bit wonky but working. I actually didn't even take advantage of the scheduling and orders for the first  40 hours of my play. I was doing things manually like a pleb for far too long. 

The tutorial is okay. I feel it needs alot of work. While i was able to get through it pretty easy, I could see how the average player may get lost in it. 

Listen, this game is hard. This game is complex and unforgiving. This game is Early Access so expect bugs, changes, fixes, and additions. Overall, aside from my disclaimer, Id say give it a shot. I have not regretted it once.
items.text_zh:
就个人而言，我喜欢这款游戏。它有着恰到好处的硬核、生存、管理、基地建设元素。当然，它可能有一些bug，但因为游戏太棒了，我常常忽略它们，同时知道它们会被优秀的开发团队修复。

画面处于较低水平，但它正合我的胃口。比起画面，我更喜欢机制和玩法。有时，我甚至觉得画面完美契合游戏的风格。

音频实际上非常出色。警报声、哔哔声、你工具的声音等等。全都很棒，完美匹配风格。

管理系统有点古怪但能用。实际上，在我游戏的前40个小时里，我甚至没有利用排程和订单。我像个小菜鸟一样手动操作了太久。

教程还行。我觉得它需要大量改进。虽然我能相当轻松地通过它，但我能看出普通玩家可能会在其中迷失。

听着，这款游戏很难。这款游戏很复杂且毫不留情。这款游戏是抢先体验版，所以预期会有bug、改动、修复和新增内容。总的来说，除了我的免责声明，我会说试一试吧。我一次都没有后悔过。

observations.description: 管理系统有些奇怪，但还能用。
observations.evidence: The management is a bit wonky but working
